note: BH-9695: how many Mergify activity-log reads (one per head, ever) the conductor makes per project per tick for a second ejection with an unknown cause. Over it, the park waits with no fix round and the parked-row pass asks again next tick. 0 = off: no Mergify event read, the cause stays unknown and the one extra requeue still runs. Each read is bounded by MERGIFY_API_TIMEOUT_S. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_eject_event_reads.
